search.snippet: What are talismans Osrs? An air tiara is made by combining an air talisman with a tiara. In order to combine it with a talisman, simply use the tiara on the air altar with an air talisman in your inventory. Doing so earns 25 Runecrafting experience. How do you make air tiara Osrs?
